name: Shinayaka Pilates
description: Shinayaka Pilates — a pilates studio theme with a formal header (studio name, menu and a Book a trial class button) whose menu runs down a fixed indigo side rail on wide screens (stacked vertical words in Chinese and Japanese). Yamabuki golden yellow (#F8B500) is the main colour: the hero field, every page head and the method band are yamabuki fields with a fan-and-wave pattern texture multiplied in, set with indigo type. The hero is split on a diagonal: the yamabuki field beside a flat illustration of the studio, with a cut-out figure stretching across the seam and over the hero edge; a cut-out ring and mat break over the method band, and the figure stretches over every page head. Classes sit in an asymmetric masonry. Every picture is a 2D flat illustration. Yomogi for display, DM Sans for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-26 (asymmetric-masonry, diagonal-split hero, side-rail nav, pattern-texture, 2d-flat, yamabuki #F8B500, Yomogi + DM Sans). A full top header (studio name, tagline, menu, Book a trial class button) whose menu runs down a fixed left indigo side rail from 1100 px (overlay menu on smaller screens). The fan-and-wave pattern (a 2D flat raster tile) is multiplied into every yamabuki field. Break-frame: the cut-out figure (transparent WebP) stretches across the hero's diagonal seam between the yamabuki field and the studio illustration and over the hero bottom edge into the studio board; the cut-out ring and mat break over the method band's top edge; the figure stretches over the diagonal edge of every page head. Traditional Chinese headings use a bundled Noto Sans TC subset (gothic, the closest to the rounded hand of Yomogi).

fonts.role: display: hero type, headings, the studio name, numbers and prices (Regular; a Latin subset and a Japanese subset of the Japanese sample text)
display for Traditional Chinese pages (Regular, subset to the characters of the zh-TW sample text; never a Japanese font)
body text, labels, buttons and the menu (variable, Latin subset)

summary.zh-TW: 山吹黃的皮拉提斯教室：斜切分割主視覺、扇與波浪花紋，去背人物越過斜線；不對稱瀑布流課程與側欄選單，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A yamabuki-yellow pilates studio: a diagonal split hero, fan-and-wave pattern and a cut-out figure stretching across the seam.
summary.ja: 山吹色のピラティススタジオ。斜めに分かれたヒーロー、扇と波の文様、境目をこえて伸びる切り抜きの人物。五か国語のサンプル付き。
summary.fr: Un studio de Pilates jaune d’or : héros coupé en diagonale, motif d’éventails et silhouette détourée qui franchit la ligne.
summary.de: Ein goldgelbes Pilates-Studio: diagonal geteilter Einstieg, Fächermuster und eine freigestellte Figur, die über die Kante greift.
